summary: Evogene Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing two items: an increase in its at-the-market offering amount from $2,926,500 to $3,288,113, and a risk factor update regarding an activist campaign. On July 10, 2026, certain shareholders filed a Schedule 13D demanding an extraordinary general meeting to remove all board members except the CEO and replace them with their nominees. The board has not stated a recommendation. The campaign may involve Israeli corporate law procedures. Watch the shareholder vote outcome, potential proxy contest costs, and impact on the ATM program and share price volatility.
